invariants: Every workflow binds exact rules-profile, schema, pack-lock and relevant object versions before analysis.
Permission filtering occurs before hidden existence, counts, derivatives, benchmark selection, charts, deltas, export, diagnostics or AI context.
All twenty factors and twelve inherited F012 pressure dimensions remain independently inspectable; no weighted aggregate is required.
No universal CR, encounter level, difficulty score, threat number or cross-domain power scalar is produced.
Unknown or source-unspecified values remain explicit gaps and may raise uncertainty to indeterminate.
Mixed-scale assessment requires explicit governing interaction rules; absence may block as indeterminate.
Benchmarks and playtest observations are evidence, not source truth or actual-player predictions.
Recommendations are advisory until explicit human acceptance through the owning encounter workflow.
Every authoritative write uses P11-MUT-001 authorization, expected_version and operation_id recovery semantics.
Accepted adjustments mutate only authorized encounter draft/configuration state; source truth and owning-domain mechanics remain immutable.
Playtest observations and calibration outcomes preserve immutable prior snapshots and receipts.
QA benchmark curation remains explicitly noncanonical and cannot auto-promote.
Semantic nonvisual projections preserve the same authorized meaning and operations as charts/visuals.
AI may explain, compare, replay or propose only; it cannot approve, mutate, attach, promote or certify balance.
No workflow activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester access, paid services or production credentials.
